context: Yumiko helps prepare for a wedding; teaches Mei traditional etiquette.
purpose: Elder woman teaching young wife formal customs.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: メイ、結婚式の挨拶、覚えてね。
lines.en: Mei, remember — the wedding toast is important.
lines.style: Warm, steadying voice. Soft opening. Not instructing from above, but settling something into place together. Breath of care underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: はい、丁寧に、伝統、守りたいです。
lines.en: Yes. I want to do it carefully, honor what's been passed down.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. Small pause after yes — gathering herself. Voice stays low and warm. Respectful without stiffness, like she's speaking a promise.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 振舞、皆さんに、感謝の気持ち、伝えるの。
lines.en: Show your appreciation to everyone. That's what matters most — how you make them feel.
lines.style: Slightly philosophical. She's not just giving instructions; she's sharing something she's learned. Slow, deliberate pace. Quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昔の私を、振り返っても、未熟でした。
lines.en: When I look back at who I was, I was so unfinished.
lines.style: Soft, inward tone. Honest vulnerability. She's not asking for reassurance — just speaking a quiet truth. Slight fadeout at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: And now look at you. You've become someone remarkable.
lines.style: Warm pride breaks through. Voice lifts slightly. Not overstated — just a mother saying what she sees. Simple, direct, genuine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 皆さんに、尽くしたい、心から。
lines.en: I want to give everything I have to everyone there. From the heart.
lines.style: Earnest and steady. Small emphasis on 'heart' — not dramatic, just where the real meaning lives. Voice stays grounded and warm.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お前なら、絶対、できるわよ。
lines.en: You'll do it beautifully. I know you will.
lines.style: Firm and quiet certainty. Not flattery — conviction. A mother saying something she absolutely believes. Slight lean forward in the voice.
